Download PEIMS financial data (budget or actual)

txs_get_peims_finance.Rd

Downloads one of TEA's PEIMS "single file" financial data downloads: fund/function/object-level budget or actual financial data for all Texas districts or all charter schools in one school year. These are statewide bulk files (district actual files run to several million rows), not per-campus reports.

Usage

txs_get_peims_finance(
  year,
  basis = c("actual", "budget"),
  type = c("district", "charter"),
  labels = TRUE,
  cache = TRUE,
  refresh = FALSE,
  output = c("tidy", "raw"),
  keep_raw = FALSE,
  db = NULL,
  timeout = 300,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

year

Integer ending year (e.g. 2024 for 2023-24).

basis

"actual" (audited actuals) or "budget" (adopted budgets).

type

"district" (traditional districts) or "charter" (open-enrollment charter schools).

labels

If TRUE, join human-readable labels for the fund/function/object/program-intent codes, plus district and campus names where available.

cache

If TRUE, reuse a cached copy when one exists.

refresh

If TRUE, re-download even if cached.

output

"tidy" (typed, padded, labeled) or "raw" (all-character columns exactly as published).

keep_raw

If TRUE, attach the raw parsed frame as attr(out, "raw").

db

Optional DuckDB file path or DBI connection. If supplied, the result is also written via txs_write_peims_db().

timeout

Seconds; default 300 (district files are tens of MB).

verbose

Print progress messages.

Value

A tibble with a txschools attribute. Tidy columns: district, district_name, fin_unit, campus_name, year, school_year, basis, type, fund_code, fund_label, function_code, function_label, object_code, object_label, program_intent_code, program_intent_label, amount, fiscal_year, updated (columns marked * appear only when labels = TRUE succeeds and TEA publishes the table).

Coverage

School years 1999-2000 (requested as ending year 2000) through the present. Actual data posts roughly a year after the fiscal year ends; budget data for the upcoming school year posts before it starts.

Granularity and labels

Rows are at the district x fund x function x object x fin-unit x program-intent grain; fin_unit identifies the campus or organization unit within the district. The raw files carry only codes. With labels = TRUE (the default) the fund, function, object, and program-intent code tables from TEA's companion "multiple file" budget archive are joined in as *_label columns, along with district and campus names where TEA publishes them. If the code tables cannot be fetched, the data is returned with codes only, with a warning.

Charter files use TEA's nonprofit chart of accounts; their asset (fund), function, object, and program-intent codes are normalized into the same fund_code, function_code, object_code, and program_intent_code columns.

No FERPA masking applies to this source: values are dollar amounts, not student counts.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
act <- txs_get_peims_finance(2024, "actual", "district")
txs_get_peims_finance(2024, "budget", "charter", db = "peims.duckdb")
} # }
